title: Fix: Overlapping appointment allowed when recurring events span across midnight
body: When a user schedules an event starting at 23:30 and ending at 00:30 the next day, the slot availability validator marks the next day slot as free, causing double booking. Solution requires checking cross-day date boundaries.

title: Validation Error: end_time before start_time returns 500 instead of 422 Unprocessable Entity
body: Submitting a schedule item where end_time <= start_time triggered an uncaught exception in the service layer instead of returning a 422 with a clear error payload to the client.

title: Bug: Cart item quantity can be incremented past available inventory stock during checkout
body: Simultaneous checkouts by two customers allowed both orders to complete even when inventory count was 1. Requires optimistic locking or reservation during payment intent creation.

title: Float precision rounding errors in total cart amount calculation
body: Floating point operations in tax calculation led to $0.01 discrepancies between Stripe charged amount and database invoice record. Recommended to store currency in cents (integers) or use Decimal.

title: Security: Unrestricted file upload allows non-PDF files in resume submission form
body: Applicants could submit arbitrary .exe or .html files under resume upload endpoint. System must enforce MIME-type inspection (application/pdf) and 5MB size limit before saving.

title: Duplicate application submissions allowed when clicking apply button repeatedly
body: Users on slow mobile connections double-clicked the Submit Application button, creating duplicate records in applications table. Enforce unique constraint on (student_id, job_id).

title: Negative expense values corrupt user balance ledger
body: API did not reject negative expense amounts in payload, allowing malicious users to arbitrarily increase their credit balances. Need strictly positive float/decimal validation.

title: CORS headers missing on 401 Unauthorized responses causing frontend browser errors
body: When token expired, FastAPI returned raw 401 without CORS origin headers, preventing the frontend SPA from reading the error and redirecting to the login page.
